*Acceptance Criteria:*
- Certificate generation script exists and is documented
- Control Plane PKI certificates are generated (broker-cert, operator-manager-ca)

*What:* Script to generate all PKI certificates needed for broker communication

*Deliverables:*
- Script file with inline comments
- Test: Run script and verify all secrets are created
